description: This file defines the SqsClient class for interacting with Amazon SQS, including methods for queue URL to ARN conversion, message attribute MD5 calculation, and MD5 validation of received messages.

classes.name: Aws	ext{Sqs}	ext{SqsClient}
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon SQS, including queue URL to ARN conversion and message MD5 validation.

methods.name: getQueueArn
methods.description: Converts a queue URL into a queue ARN, handling FIFO queue suffixes.

methods.name: calculateMessageAttributesMd5
methods.description: Calculates the MD5 hash of message attributes according to AWS SQS encoding scheme.

methods.name: calculateBodyMd5
methods.description: Calculates MD5 hash of message body.

methods.name: getEncodedStringPiece
methods.description: Encodes a string piece with length prefix for MD5 calculation.

methods.name: getEncodedBinaryPiece
methods.description: Encodes binary data with length prefix for MD5 calculation.

methods.name: getFourBytePieceLength
methods.description: Returns a 4-byte length prefix for a given string.

methods.name: validateMd5
methods.description: Returns a callable that validates the MD5 hashes of received message bodies and attributes.
